(2) The woman covers the crouching man with the blanket and drops it after a countdown; the man is no longer visible in the frame. The setting is a brightly lit indoor home with white walls and a small kitchen counter visible in the background. (3) The camera cuts to the two boys on the mat; the older boy looks around with a puzzled expression while the toddler remains still. (5) The older boy, now wearing blue patterned pajamas, attempts to perform the same trick in a different room, throwing a blanket and running behind a wall corner. (6) A close-up shot shows the older boy sitting on a bed with a grey headboard and several colorful plush toys. He smiles broadly and points to his temple while speaking to someone off-camera.
